source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Falcon (Sam Wilson) (archived 8 March 2018)

powerOrigins.detail: Wakandan vibranium wings, designed by Black Panther and upgraded over the years, let him fly at up to 250 mph.
Intensive training from Steve Rogers made him a master acrobat, martial artist and aerial fighter.
The reality-altering Cosmic Cube bonded his mind to his falcon Redwing, a link that later grew to cover all birds.

abilities.name: Avian telepathy
abilities.detail: Links mentally with any bird, commanding flocks in a fight and seeing through their eyes for surveillance.

abilities.name: Winged flight
abilities.detail: His vibranium wings absorb impacts, reconfigure for different flight modes and respond through a cybernetic link.

abilities.name: Aerial combat
abilities.detail: Counted among the best aerial fighters in the world, rivalling Iron Man and Captain Marvel in the air.

abilities.name: Martial arts and acrobatics
abilities.detail: Trained in several fighting styles and gymnastics by Steve Rogers; acrobatics were his main tool before he could fly.

abilities.name: Shield fighting
abilities.detail: As Captain America he throws the shield to hit several targets from the air with pinpoint accuracy.

abilities.name: Leadership
abilities.detail: Has led S.H.I.E.L.D. Super-Agents and the Avengers, helped by his people skills as a social worker.

feats.text: Strapped to a tank by Sin's men, he broke free of his bonds and went on to stop her Hydra attack.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: All-New Captain America Vol 1 3

feats.text: Stabbed through the chest by Zemo's sword, he kept fighting and summoned a flock of birds to turn the battle.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: All-New Captain America Vol 1 5

feats.text: Sent Redwing and a flock of falcons at the Red Skull, giving Black Panther the opening to defeat him.
Flew straight into a launching Helicarrier's gunfire, dodging its guns and a pursuing Quinjet while fighting Hydra on deck.

feats.text: In his new suit, he saved two officers from a damaged helicopter, then pulled a Flag Smasher out of a hostage-filled chopper.
